description: Indexing status of the property's inspected URLs (Search Console URL Inspection results stored by Organiq, plus the tracked_urls watch list): healthScore 0–100 (70 % indexed share + 30 % fresh-crawl share), indexed / not indexed counts, breakdown by coverageState and verdict, crawl freshness (fresh <= 30 days, aging, stale >= 120 days, never), alerts (deindexed since an earlier check, fetch errors, robots blocks, canonical mismatch, stale crawl, not indexed) and coverage over time by week of check. hasData=false means no inspection has been stored for this property yet (the inspection sync is not enabled for the account). The submissions field adds the last indexing request per URL (request_indexing: last submission time, state, cause, last inspection). Use for "are my pages indexed", "did Google drop a page", crawl staleness. / Saúde de indexação das URLs inspecionadas: nota 0–100, cobertura, frescor de crawl e alertas.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.
